sources.entry: DDraceNetwork - Cooperative platformer version of DDRace, a Teeworlds modification featuring unique cooperative gameplay. (Source Code) Zlib C++

summary.one_liner: DDNet is a cooperative DDRace platformer game client and server, a Teeworlds modification, written in C++.
summary.what_it_does: The README describes DDNet as its own flavor of DDRace, a Teeworlds mod. It builds the game client and game server with CMake, using Ninja or Visual Studio. Required libraries include SDL2, FFmpeg, Vulkan, OpenSSL, SQLite and Opus, and many can be swapped for bundled copies or disabled with CMake flags such as -DVULKAN=OFF. The README also covers Git cloning options (shallow, full history, with or without bundled libraries), vim and neovim syntax files for config files, and a PRECOMPILE_HEADERS option. Official binaries are available from the DDNet website, Steam, and distribution packages. Development docs for benchmarking, the official database, and debugging live under docs/.
use_cases: Building the DDNet game client from source
Contributing code to a Teeworlds mod
Installing DDNet from a Linux, macOS, or FreeBSD package manager
how_to_run: sudo apt install build-essential cargo cmake git glslang-tools google-mock libavcodec-extra libavdevice-dev libavfilter-dev libavformat-dev libavutil-dev libcurl4-openssl-dev libfreetype6-dev libglew-dev libnotify-dev libogg-dev libopus-dev libopusfile-dev libpng-dev libsdl2-dev libsqlite3-dev libssl-dev libvulkan-dev libwavpack-dev libx264-dev ninja-build python3 rustc spirv-tools
notable: Cooperative DDRace gameplay within the Teeworlds modding ecosystem
Shallow and full-history clone options that trade download size against bundled libraries
Builds with system libraries by default, with a flag to use bundled ones
Packaged for Debian, Ubuntu, Fedora, Arch, macOS (Homebrew), FreeBSD, and Scoop
Ships vim and neovim syntax highlighting for config files
caveats: Building from source needs many system libraries, and some are not bundled (for example OpenSSL and Vulkan), so setup can be heavy
Full-history clones are roughly 1 GiB with libraries and about 450 MiB without them
Vulkan is disabled by default on Windows and must be enabled with an SDK installed
